transportationNotes: Pagbilao is a link between the Bondoc Peninsula, Bicol Region, and Lucena City.
Bicol-bound buses pass through the municipality.
Common terminals are situated at the Grand Terminal in Lucena City.
Jeepney routes mentioned by the municipal website include Lucena City, Barangay Bigo, Silangang Malicboy, and Grande Island.
